source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
As your turn starts, if you have fulfilled your current Oath, determine another Oath as the army rules describe, with these limits:

- No Deed or Quality already picked can be picked again; if a random roll gives one, pick an unpicked one instead.
- Once every Deed and Quality has been picked, no further Oath is determined.

Qualities of fulfilled Oaths keep applying to all your models with **[Code Chivalric](vsdata:ability/imperial-knights.code-chivalric)**. Completing the Deed of an additional Oath gives you 1CP in place of its usual reward, however that Deed or Quality was chosen.
